fragments.maya: a girl age 11 with deep brown skin, black hair in two round puff buns, coral orange sweater
fragments.theo: a boy age 11 with light tan skin, short dark brown hair, round gold glasses, charcoal navy sweater
fragments.zara: a girl age 11 with light peach skin, short black bob haircut, teal shirt
fragments.dev: a boy age 11 with warm tan skin, short rust brown hair, bright orange t-shirt
fragments.bram: an adult man vendor with fair skin, dark gray hair and angry slanted eyebrows, teal jacket over a charcoal apron

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Comic book cover, low angle, a lantern-lit pier at night. Exactly four kids stand at the bottom, left to right: {{maya}}; {{theo}}; {{zara}}; {{dev}}. {{vex}} floats upper right. Top third plain navy sky.
panels.alt: Amara, Lucas, Hana and Eliot stand together on the lantern-lit festival pier at night while VEX, the teal robot with one golden eye, floats above them.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide night panel on {{pier}}. Exactly three kids stand in a row in the lower half, smiling: {{maya}}; {{zara}}; {{dev}}. {{vex}} floats at top right. The lower left corner is dark empty boardwalk.
panels.alt: Amara, Hana and Eliot stand smiling under strings of glowing lanterns on the festival pier at night, VEX floating at the top right.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. A big wooden board on a pier at night holding one hundred round glowing bulbs in a neat ten by ten grid, all lit warm gold. Dark navy sky behind, no people.
panels.alt: The hundred-bulb lantern board glows on the pier at night, all one hundred bulbs lit.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide night panel of {{pier}}. In the center stands {{therm}}, its column about half lit. At left {{maya}} holds a stick of chalk, excited. At right {{bram}} spreads his arms with a pushy grin beside his stall.
panels.alt: Mid-festival on the pier: Amara holds chalk beside the tall pier-fund thermometer, half lit, while Bram the rival vendor spreads his arms with a pushy grin at his stall.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Medium shot of {{theo}} at the left, deadpan, holding a small notebook, under hanging lanterns. Dark navy night background, the right side empty.
panels.alt: Lucas, deadpan, holds his notebook under the lanterns.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide night panel of a games alley on {{pier}}: a coral striped ring-toss booth with rows of bottles and a heap of round gold tokens on its counter. At left {{dev}} holds a bucket of tokens. At right {{zara}} taps her chin, thinking.
panels.alt: In the games alley, Eliot holds a bucket of tokens beside a ring-toss booth heaped with gold tokens while Hana taps her chin, thinking.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. {{vex}} at the far right beside a cyan hologram of a messy pile of coins turning into one neat round stack. Dark navy background, the left two thirds empty.
panels.alt: VEX glows beside a hologram of a messy pile of coins turning into one neat stack.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Medium shot of {{dev}} at the left, holding up two gold tokens with a grin, a long line of blurry festival-goers behind him. Dark navy night background, the right side empty.
panels.alt: Eliot grins and holds up two gold tokens while a long line waits behind him.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide night panel of a teal market stall with a wooden counter. On the stall's back wall at the right hang two blank white paper notices, one above the other. A crate of paper lanterns sits on the counter. At left stands {{maya}}, hugging a big ledger book.
panels.alt: Amara hugs a big ledger at a teal market stall, a crate of paper lanterns on the counter and two notices pinned to the wall.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Close-up of {{theo}}, pushing up his glasses with one finger, a smug knowing look, lanterns glowing behind. The top third is dark navy night.
panels.alt: Close-up of Lucas pushing up his round glasses with a knowing look.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. {{vex}} hovering beside a cyan hologram of two glowing bars of different heights side by side. Dark navy background, the top half empty.
panels.alt: VEX glows beside a hologram of two bars of different heights, ready to compare.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Medium shot of {{maya}} at the left, pressing a stick of chalk to a small blank chalkboard, determined. Dark navy night background, the right side empty.
panels.alt: Amara presses her chalk to a small chalkboard, determined.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide night panel of two market stalls side by side, a coral one at left and a teal one at right, each with a blank white sign board on its counter. Between them stands {{zara}}, hands on hips, puzzled. Strings of lanterns above.
panels.alt: Hana stands puzzled between a coral stall and a teal stall, each with a counter sign, under strings of lanterns.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. {{vex}} at the far right beside a big cyan hologram gear turning backwards with a curved arrow. Dark navy background, the left two thirds empty.
panels.alt: VEX glows beside a hologram of a big gear turning backwards.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Medium shot of {{zara}} at the left, pointing back over her shoulder with her thumb, a sly grin, a wooden restock cart behind her. Dark navy night background, the right side empty.
panels.alt: Hana points back over her shoulder with a sly grin, a restock cart behind her.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide night panel on {{pier}}. At left {{bram}} shouts into a megaphone. At right stands {{therm}}, its column more than half lit. In the middle {{maya}} and {{dev}} wince and cover their ears.
panels.alt: Bram shouts into a megaphone on the pier while Amara and Eliot wince and cover their ears beside the pier-fund thermometer, now more than half lit.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. {{vex}} at the far right pulsing with jagged red warning rings around its eye. Dark navy background, the left two thirds empty.
panels.alt: VEX pulses with jagged red warning rings.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Night panel on {{pier}}. A big blank cream sign board fills the center left. At right stands {{therm}}, its column more than half lit. At far left {{maya}} points up at the board. {{vex}} glows small at the lower right.
panels.alt: Amara points up at the big pier-fund sign beside the thermometer, more than half lit, as VEX glows at the lower right.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Medium shot of {{theo}} at the left, arms crossed with a calm confident smile, a crowd of lanterns behind. Dark navy night background, the right side empty.
panels.alt: Lucas crosses his arms with a calm, confident smile.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. {{vex}} glows intensely at the far right in a dark navy void, rays of golden light fanning out behind it. The left two thirds are empty dark.
panels.alt: VEX glows intensely in the dark, golden rays fanning out behind it.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Night celebration on a lantern-lit pier. A long blank navy banner across the top. Below, exactly four kids cheer, fists up: {{maya}}; {{theo}}; {{zara}}; {{dev}}. {{vex}} glows at the right.
panels.alt: Under a long banner on the festival pier, Amara, Lucas, Hana and Eliot cheer with their fists in the air while VEX glows beside them.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Close-up of {{bram}}, sheepish and embarrassed, rubbing the back of his neck and holding a megaphone at his side. The top third is dark navy night.
panels.alt: Close-up of Bram, sheepish, rubbing his neck with the megaphone at his side.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. A blank cream poster in a gold frame glowing on a wooden market gate at night, lanterns on either side. {{vex}} floats small at the top. Dark navy sky.
